question: In May 2025, the Khelo India Multipurpose Hall in Arunachal Pradesh was officially opened in which district by Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Khelo India Multipurpose Hall in Arunachal Pradesh was inaugurated in May 2025 by Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya in the **Kamle district**.
 
• This initiative aligns with the **Khelo India Programme**, which aims to enhance sports infrastructure and promote sports culture across the nation.
 
• The multipurpose hall is equipped to host various sports activities and events, encouraging local talent and youth participation in sports.
 
• Kamle district, being one of the youngest districts of Arunachal Pradesh, has been receiving attention for development initiatives, including sports infrastructure.
 
• The Khelo India Multipurpose Hall is expected to serve as a hub for nurturing sports talent and fostering community engagement in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lower Subansiri**

 
 
• Lower Subansiri is known for its picturesque landscapes and cultural heritage.
 
• It is home to Ziro Valley, a popular tourist destination famous for its scenic beauty and Ziro Music Festival.
 
• The district has also been a focus for agricultural and eco-tourism initiatives.
 
 
 
• **West Kameng**
 
 
• West Kameng is renowned for its biodiversity and stunning natural beauty.
 
• It houses several tourist attractions, including Bomdila Monastery and Sela Pass.
 
• The district plays a significant role in preserving indigenous traditions and promoting eco-tourism.
 
 
 
• **Tawang**
 
 
• Tawang is one of the most famous districts in Arunachal Pradesh, known for Tawang Monastery, the largest monastery in India.
 
• The district has a strategic location near the Indo-China border, making it geopolitically significant.
 
• Tawang also attracts tourists for its breathtaking landscapes, snow-capped mountains, and rich Tibetan heritage.
